Eug. Ludovicus-Maria Lion, Archiep. Dam. Del. Ap. Catholic affiliation is established by this leaf, not inferred solely from the Dominican printer.

alternate_titles: Service de la Messe selon le rit syrien avec les prières qui se disent pour les morts
work.author: Syriac Catholic Church liturgical tradition
work.description: Syriac Catholic auxiliary Mass service and prayers for the dead, represented by the Mosul 1881 edition. Ignace Ziadé, Dictionnaire de théologie catholique 14.2 (1941), col. 3026, identifies the 1868/1881 Service de la messe as an early diaconicon for deacon/server parts. The stable legacy work ID is not a claim that this is a celebrant altar missal or the predecessor of the separate 1922 Missale Syriacum.
